name: @rue-js/runtime-vapor
description: Rue runtime implemented in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly
author: Xiangmin Liu

scripts.build-profiling: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --profiling --target bundler --out-dir pkg --features dev --features log && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build-dev: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target bundler --out-dir pkg --features dev --features log && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target bundler --out-dir pkg && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build-node: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node --features log --features dev && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build-reactive-dev: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target bundler --out-dir pkg-reactive --no-default-features --features dev --features log && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build-reactive: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target bundler --out-dir pkg-reactive --no-default-features && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build-node-reactive: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node-reactive --no-default-features --features log --features dev && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build-vapor-dev: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target bundler --out-dir pkg-vapor --no-default-features --features runtime --features dev --features log && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build-vapor: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target bundler --out-dir pkg-vapor --no-default-features --features runtime && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build-node-vapor: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node-vapor --no-default-features --features runtime --features log --features dev && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build-reactive && npm run build-vapor
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run build-reactive && npm run build-vapor
